title: Naturally Sweet Dutch Passion Fruit Pancakes
description: A kid-friendly Dutch dish featuring passion fruit pulp, these pancakes are mustardy, chewy, and perfect for a breakfast treat. They are also raw-friendly and made with natural ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, oats, and honey.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Fold in the passion fruit pulp and mustard seeds.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm and enjoy!
